name: LWR UO2 pin with burnup (properties sourced, the rest synthetic)
label: synthetic

thermal.conductivity.source: NUREG/CR-7024 (PNNL-19417) Eq. 2.3-10 and 2.3-11: FRAPCON-3.4 modified NFI model, pages 2.11 and 2.12; range of applicability section 2.3.2, page 2.20
MATPRO CTHCON, NUREG/CR-7024 Eq. 3.2-1 (page 3.4) and MATPRO-Version 11 Eq. B-2.3: k = 7.51 + 2.09e-2 T - 1.45e-5 T^2 + 7.67e-9 T^3 W/m/K, T in K, below 2098 K

gap.source: synthetic: chosen for the closed-form oracle

description: A typical PWR pin at 20 kW/m: UO2 fuel at 95 % of theoretical density with FRAPCON-3.4's modified NFI conductivity at a stated burnup (40 MWd/kgHM), Zircaloy cladding with MATPRO's conductivity. The two conductivity laws are sourced (NUREG/CR-7024, pages in the library entries); the dimensions, the power, the coolant and the gap conductance are chosen for the example, not taken from a design, so the case is labelled synthetic. A frozen-burnup snapshot: change the burnup in the Burnup item, and see the burnup plot for the cost of burnup on this pin. Nothing evolves: no swelling, densification or fission-gas release, and the gap is held at its stated value.
